notes: Background: mid-market product analytics vendor (SaaS) building a conversational assistant + search layer across product docs and user logs.
Started 14-day Hosted API trial in mid-Feb; synthetic and real traffic injected to mirror production mix.
Product team quote: 'Latency matters for discovery flows — if answers take >400ms users drop off'.
Primary interest: move from Hosted API to Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost once sizing validated.
POC scope: chat assistant (context windows ~2-8k), semantic search embeddings for doc search, and reranking pipeline for results rebiasing.
Finance: CFO wants committed capacity pricing for FY27 budget planning; looking at 12–24 month commit option.
technical_summary: Trial metrics (last 10 days): sustained 45 QPS peak, burst to 120 QPS during feature launches.
Observed concurrency: 110 concurrent streams at 95th percentile during load test; target for Dedicated: support 150 concurrent chat sessions with <350ms p95 generation latency for short responses.
Token mix (observed): ~70% requests 0-128 tokens, ~25% requests 128-1024 tokens, ~5% requests >2048 tokens; average tokens per request ~420.
Throughput requirements: expected steady-state QPS 35-60 with daily peaks to 150; nightly batch reranking jobs that need throughput but can be scheduled to Dedicated low-priority nodes.
Model preferences: prefer open-model variants comparable to gpt-4o-quality; want quantized/8-bit variants for cost savings; require model pinning and deterministic rollbacks.
Routing/fallback: need smart routing to cheaper model variant on non-critical paths and automatic fallback to hosted replicas in other region during capacity events.
SLOs: 99.5% availability, p95 latency <350ms for interactive short completions, cost per 1k tokens target <= $0.80 (for generation workloads) after optimization.
Data controls: all inference logs must be encrypted at rest, stored only in US/EU (data residency), and exportable for audits (audit_logging).
